m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Xipli Tailbiter sent you for some Salt of Stone? I have some that's been boiled down, filtered, and sun dried.
Yes, you can have some, but... well, make sure you don't stand too close when he performs his experiment.
You need some Sulfur for Xipli Tailbiter? I would like to help you, little one, but the Crazed Thunder Horns took it from me.
Perhaps if you confront them in Three Points, you can get some Sulfur from them?
Xipli wants Charcoal? That fool, does he want to burn us all to our end before the comet strikes us down?
Yes, yes, you can have some, but I dropped it in my rush to get to safety. You'll have to collect it from Three Points on your own.
You got everything? Heh heh heh.
You need to get through the rubble to rescue Tezcat Threestar? Into the Maw? Heh heh heh. I can perhaps help you with that.
If you will help me gather some ingredients, I can make you a Strong Concoction.
Go to Lakwilo Smoke Eye and ask for Salt of Stone. Then Canica Sweet Chile, for Sulfur. And Charcoal from Poteka White Ash.
And then? Then you'll see Tezcat Threestar, heh heh heh.
Talk to Lakwilo Smoke Eye for Salt of Stone, to Canica Sweet Chile for Sulfur, and Poteka White Ash for Charcoal.
And then we'll make a Strong Concoction! Heh heh heh!
